record.paper_title: Stability of Homomorphisms, Coverings and Cocycles II: Examples, Applications and Open Problems
record.original_question: For each integer d at least 2, does there exist a family of finite d-dimensional bounded-degree topological expanders, meaning simplicial complexes of dimension d whose vertex degrees are uniformly bounded and that satisfy Gromov's topological overlapping property?

evidence.quote: Problem 1.2. For d ≥ 2, are there families of d-dimensional bounded degree topological expanders?
Problem 1.2 was resolved in full — first for d = 2 in [KKL16], and later for all dimensions in [EK16] — without resolving Problem 1.3.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A finite simplicial complex $X$ of dimension $d$ is said to have uniformly bounded degree if there is a constant $D$ such that every vertex of $X$ is contained in at most $D$ faces. A family $\{X_n\}_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ of $d$-dimensional finite simplicial complexes (with $|X_n|\to\infty$) is said to satisfy Gromov's topological overlapping property if there exists a constant $c>0$ such that for every $n$ and every continuous map $f\colon X_n\to\mathbb{R}^d$, there exists a point $p\in\mathbb{R}^d$ whose preimage $f^{-1}(p)$ meets at least $c\cdot f_d(X_n)$ of the $d$-dimensional faces of $X_n$, where $f_d(X_n)$ denotes the number of $d$-faces of $X_n$. Such a family is called a family of $d$-dimensional bounded-degree topological expanders if both conditions hold.

Question: For every integer $d\geq 2$, does there exist a family of finite $d$-dimensional bounded-degree topological expanders?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem has been resolved affirmatively. Kaufman–Kazhdan–Lubotzky (2016) constructed bounded-degree topological expanders in dimension 2, and Evra–Kaufman (2016) extended the construction to all dimensions $d \geq 2$ using high-dimensional Ramanujan complexes and a local-to-global theorem for coboundary expansion.

status_evidence.title: Bounded degree cosystolic expanders of every dimension (Evra–Kaufman)
status_evidence.snippet: We present an explicit construction of bounded degree simplicial complexes of every dimension which are cosystolic expanders, and in particular have the topological overlapping property.
status_evidence.claim: Evra and Kaufman constructed bounded-degree topological expanders of every dimension d ≥ 2.

status_evidence.title: Isoperimetric inequalities for Ramanujan complexes and topological expanders (Kaufman–Kazhdan–Lubotzky)
status_evidence.snippet: We construct bounded degree 2-dimensional simplicial complexes which are topological expanders, answering a question of Gromov.
